biological_support.statistical_interpretation: WXS shows one q<0.05 enrichment (BAP1) with wide CI, plus directionally consistent PBRM1 depletion and ATM absence at q~0.06. RNA pathway analysis shows many significant, moderate-to-large standardized effects.

limitations: WXS tested only 13 genes; BAP1 CI is very wide.
Pathway scores are relative to the complementary set, not an external reference.

limitations: Resampling used the existing SNF affinity subgraph; affinities were not re-estimated.
Structural characterization does not independently validate biological subtype identity.

observations.finding: Global Cramer's V 0.418, q=0.008; C0001 depleted for BP (set fraction 0.24 vs rest 0.65, OR 0.17, q=0.0013).

limitations: tissue_source_site is a site/batch variable that may correlate with biology and cannot be fully disentangled here.

limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels were assessable.
